next.notebook.label: Jupyter Notebook
next.notebook.trustNotice: Opening a file does not run code. Execution uses Python on this machine with access to files, just like a terminal. Only allow execution for notebooks you trust. Save results with the usual Save button.
next.notebook.pythonOnly: Only the Python 3 kernel is supported for now. This notebook uses another kernel; its saved cells and outputs can still be viewed and edited.
next.notebook.empty: This notebook has no cells yet.
next.notebook.unsupportedOutput: This output format is not supported. It is preserved in the file.
